# NAMI STUDIO

> Japandi interior design studio in Sydney, NSW, Australia, led by Japanese-born designer Nanami Ura. Designs homes (new builds, renovations, single rooms, budget styling with IKEA and Kmart, Japanese gardens) and commercial spaces (cafés, restaurants, salons, massage and wellness clinics, retail, offices). Backed by Japan Homes' 20+ years of building experience. NAMI STUDIO designs and arranges licensed builders; it does not build. Founder qualifications include interior design and property styling, Japanese garden design, contemporary Japanese architecture (The University of Tokyo), NSW real estate registration and a Japanese real estate licence (Takken-shi).

Specialties: hinoki (Japanese cypress) bathrooms and ofuro soaking tubs, shoji screens, tatami rooms and corners, washi paper lighting, genkan entries, engawa-style decks, wabi-sabi styling, Japanese gardens.

Contact: hello@nami-studio.com.au · +61 406 880 243 · Instagram @nami.studio_au
